analysis.reason: 3일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간에서 벗어나려 시도하나, MACD 히스토그램은 여전히 음수이며 개선되는 모습이다. 거래량은 5일 평균 대비 0.37배로 위축되어 있어 추세 전환의 신뢰도가 낮다. 주봉 ADX 47.7은 뚜렷한 추세를 나타내지만, 일봉상으로는 아직 방향성이 명확하지 않다.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive days. RSI is attempting to break out of oversold territory, while MACD histogram remains negative but shows improvement. Trading volume is subdued at 0.37x the 5-day average, lowering confidence in a trend reversal. Weekly ADX at 47.7 indicates a clear trend, but the daily chart lacks clear direction.

analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 consecutive trading days. Today, RSI shows signs of exiting oversold territory and MACD histogram is improving, but the lack of volume prevents confirmation of a trend reversal. Therefore, the wait-and-see approach continues.
